name: ALTER COLUMN (GA)
description: ALTER COLUMN to non-nullable lets customers enforce "this column must always have a value" directly, in place, no more full table rebuilds just to tighten a constraint. It saves time, avoids error-prone workarounds (CTAS, drop/rename), and preserves table history. Combined with default-constraint support, existing rows get backfilled automatically, so the change is safe and non-breaking.

result.descriptionEs: ALTER COLUMN a NOT NULL permitirá exigir que una columna tenga siempre valor directamente sobre la tabla existente, sin reconstruirla (CTAS o drop/rename) y conservando su historial. Junto con las restricciones DEFAULT, las filas existentes se rellenan automáticamente, por lo que el cambio es seguro.
